synthetic_sql_fixture.method: 60 local SQLite CLI invocations/query, cold process overhead included, synthetic history, separate database; not application latency or production SLA

source_time.query: SELECT event_key,at_ms,payload_json FROM collection_events WHERE data_source_id='source-a' AND at_ms BETWEEN 19000 AND 21000 AND (at_ms,event_key)>(19500,'') ORDER BY at_ms,event_key LIMIT 101

plan.detail: SEARCH collection_events USING INDEX history_events (data_source_id=? AND at_ms>? AND at_ms<?)

kind_time.query: SELECT event_key,at_ms FROM collection_events WHERE data_source_id='source-a' AND kind='connection_lost' AND at_ms BETWEEN 19000 AND 21000 ORDER BY at_ms,event_key LIMIT 101

plan.detail: SEARCH collection_events USING COVERING INDEX history_events_kind (data_source_id=? AND kind=? AND at_ms>? AND at_ms<?)

event_detail.query: SELECT event_key,payload_json FROM collection_events WHERE event_key=printf('%064x',50000) AND data_source_id='source-a'

plan.detail: SEARCH collection_events USING INDEX events_key_source (event_key=? AND data_source_id=?)

source_parent.query: SELECT s.source_id FROM source_placements s JOIN sites p ON s.site_id=p.id JOIN infrastructures i ON p.infrastructure_id=i.id WHERE i.organization_id='org-a'

plan.detail: SEARCH i USING COVERING INDEX infrastructures_parent (organization_id=?)
SEARCH p USING COVERING INDEX sites_parent (infrastructure_id=?)
SEARCH s USING COVERING INDEX placements_site (site_id=?)
